text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both treading water with minimal daily gains, suggesting cautious consolidation rather than conviction in either direction. The Fear & Greed index at 24 signals extreme fear, though the 12-point weekly rise indicates some recovery in sentiment from deeper panic, while Bitcoin's elevated dominance at 55.7% reflects capital rotating toward the largest asset during uncertainty. Volume at $55B is moderate, typical of a market waiting for catalysts rather than one actively capitulating or surging.
